git_tracked.description: Link only files that git tracks. Packages and link groups can override it. Defaults to true.

link_type.description: Link type for all packages in this config.

packages.description: Packages, keyed by name. Names must be unique in a state directory.

state_dir.description: State directory, relative to the config file.

LinkGroup.description: A set of source files that link into one target directory.

git_tracked.description: Link only files that git tracks. Overrides the package and config values.

rename.description: Rules that give sources a different path at the target. Only the first rule that matches a source applies, and a source that no rule matches keeps its path.

root.description: Directory that the source globs are relative to, relative to the config file. Defaults to the package name.

sources.description: Globs that select source files. Defaults to `**/*`, every file in `root`.

target.description: Target directory. Each match goes here, at its path relative to `root`.

LinkType.description: How symsync stores every path of a package.

oneOf.description: All links and recorded paths are absolute.
All links and recorded paths are relative, so the chain works after the repo and state directory move together.

git_tracked.description: Link only files that git tracks. Overrides the config value, and link groups can override it.

Rename.description: A rule that gives matching sources a different path at the target.

from.description: Glob that matches the source path, relative to `root`.

to.description: Target path, relative to `target`. `{n}` is the text of capture `n` of `from`, `{0}` is the whole source path, and `{{` and `}}` are literal braces.
